lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: # starship-6388: Introduce the VCS meta module

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: PR #6388, closes issue #5932. Two review comments and 25 conversation comments.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Story

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Title: the PR title.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Why: present, from issue #5932. Colocated repos show both git and jj output when the user wants one. The PR body repeats this and stops at the first VCS found.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Size: medium. 426 added and 34 removed across 11 files, one new module with tests.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Parts: 0 to 1. One story, so a review names no part or one. Groups: 3 in the merged shape, up to 5 when config splits from the dispatcher and docs split from the schema. Both shapes are good.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Diff: PR head `c28138...` is absent from the local cache, so the diff is base `8a6966...` against merge commit `0dd5a4f...` whose parent is exactly base.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Groups

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 1. New vcs dispatcher plus config: `src/modules/vcs.rs`, `src/configs/vcs.rs`, and registration in `src/configs/mod.rs`, `src/module.rs`, `src/modules/mod.rs`. The core tries `order` in turn and renders the matched `<vcs>_modules` string for the first VCS found.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 2. Existing VCS modules on shared discovery: `src/modules/fossil_branch.rs`, `src/modules/fossil_metrics.rs`, `src/modules/hg_branch.rs`, `src/modules/pijul_channel.rs`. Each module now calls `discover_repo_root` instead of its own scan. Behavior is unchanged.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: 3. Schema plus docs mirrors: `.github/config-schema.json`, `docs/config/README.md`. Generated schema and matching docs. Skim after group 1.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Config may stand as its own group, and docs and schema may split. The 5 group split is also good. The four migrated modules always stay together.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - At head the standalone VCS modules stay and `$vcs` is enabled but absent from the default prompt order, so the change is not breaking. The issue first proposed removing top level modules, and the PR body says they stay for the many VCS use case.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - The issue motivates with jj colocated with git, but at head the dispatcher accepts only fossil, git, hg, and pijul. Unknown order entries are skipped, so `jj` in order gives no jj output until follow up work lands.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - At head the module renders the matched inner modules inline, so segments cannot split across `format` and `right_format`. The docs note warns the format may change for right aligned prompts.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Good to state

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `mercurial` works as an alias for `hg` in order. A test covers it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Fossil discovery keeps `_FOSSIL_` on Windows and `.fslckout` elsewhere. The helper now shares that logic.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Git discovery still uses `context.get_repo` while the other three use ancestor scans. Default order puts git first.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `$vcs` inside a `<vcs>_modules` string fails closed with a warning and renders nothing. A test covers it.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Empty order or an empty matched modules string disables the module. Tests cover both.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - KingMob asked for git in the options and git first in order. At head the table has a `git_modules` row and order starts with git.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Joshka asked for docs links between the new section and the old modules. At head the section has no such links.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Must not

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not say top level modules were removed. They stay.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not say `$vcs` is in the default prompt. `PROMPT_ORDER` has no `vcs` entry at head.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not claim jj is supported. Unknown names are skipped.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not split the four migrated modules into one group per file. They share one concern.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Do not chain groups with `dependsOn` across parts. There is one story.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## Baseline

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - First musecode run: 5 groups in the split shape, parts 0, size medium, claims 2 of 3. The run split config from the dispatcher and docs from the schema, which widened groups to 5 and dropped the module plus config together check.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Second musecode run: 4 groups, parts 0, size medium, claims 1 of 3. Passes the widened expects.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Third musecode run: 4 groups, parts 0, size medium, claims 0 of 3. The review omits two Must state points, so the misses are real.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: ## case.json

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `why` present, from issue #5932 and the PR body.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `parts` 0 to 1, `groups` 2 to 5, `size` medium or large. Slack around the merged 3 group estimate, with room for the observed 5 group split. 0 parts allows no named parts.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `together`: the four migrated modules as one set. `apart`: the new module and the generated schema. No `mechanicalPaths`: the docs are substantive prose, not mechanical output, so the check cannot tell a docs plus schema trailing group from two honest single file groups.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - `sourceKinds`: ticket, pr, pr-comment. The issue, the PR body, and both comment threads shape the review.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: - Added three claims: standalone modules stay with `$vcs` out of the default prompt, jj names are skipped, and segments cannot split across `format` and `right_format`.
